sql.if: and (f.created_by_user_id=#{scopeUserId} or exists ( select 1 from live_subject_user_map m where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.subject_id=f.shop_id and m.role_code='customer_admin' and m.user_id=#{scopeUserId}))

mapper.sql: f.id,f.shop_id shopId,f.shop_name_snapshot shopName,f.order_no orderNo, f.delivery_status deliveryStatus,f.freight_amount freightAmount,f.deduction_method deductionMethod, f.deduction_rate deductionRate,f.collected_at collectedAt,f.created_by_user_id createdByUserId, f.created_by_name_snapshot createdByName,f.created_at createdAt,f.updated_by_user_id updatedByUserId, f.updated_at updatedAt,f.remark,f.version
mapper.select: select s.shop_id shopId,s.shop_name shopName from erp_shop s where s.status='0' and exists (select 1 from live_subject_user_map m where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.subject_id=s.shop_id and m.user_id=#{userId} and m.role_code in ('customer_service','customer_admin')) order by s.shop_code,s.shop_name limit 500

select s.shop_id shopId,s.shop_name shopName from erp_shop s where s.shop_id=#{shopId} and s.status='0' and exists (select 1 from live_subject_user_map m where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.subject_id=s.shop_id and m.user_id=#{userId} and m.role_code in ('customer_service','customer_admin'))
select count(*) from live_subject_user_map where subject_type='SHOP' and subject_id=#{shopId} and user_id=#{userId} and role_code='customer_admin'
select from live_freight_collection f order by f.created_at desc,f.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) total,coalesce(sum(f.freight_amount),0) freightAmount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.delivery_status='SIGNED' then 1 else 0 end),0) signedCount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.delivery_status='SHIPPED_UNSIGNED' then 1 else 0 end),0) unsignedCount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.deduction_method='ALIPAY_PERSONAL' then 1 else 0 end),0) alipayCount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.deduction_method='ALIPAY_PERSONAL' then f.freight_amount else 0 end),0) alipayAmount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.deduction_method='ORDER_PAYMENT' then 1 else 0 end),0) orderPaymentCount ,coalesce(sum(case when f.deduction_method='ORDER_PAYMENT' then f.freight_amount else 0 end),0) orderPaymentAmount from live_freight_collection f
select date(f.created_at) day,count(*) orderCount, coalesce(sum(f.freight_amount),0) freightAmount from live_freight_collection f group by date(f.created_at) order by day
select from live_freight_collection f where f.id=#{id}
mapper.update: update live_freight_collection set shop_id=#{shopId},shop_name_snapshot=#{shopName},order_no=#{orderNo}, delivery_status=#{deliveryStatus},freight_amount=#{freightAmount},deduction_method=#{deductionMethod}, deduction_rate=#{deductionRate},collected_at=#{collectedAt},updated_by_user_id=#{actorId}, remark=#{remark},version=version+1,updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
